title: ophrys sphegodes subsp. fuchsii
intro: Ophrys sphegodes subsp. fuchsii, commonly known as the Bee Orchid, is a subspecies of orchid native to Europe and parts of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, which help to loosen and clear mucus from the airways. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys sphegodes subsp. fuchsii include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
